_why: DRYDOCK (NIGHT15 U3-28.6; MAP-DESIGN.md sections 3.1 and 4): "Finish the ship, or fight on its bones." A sky-shipyard cut into a cliff at dusk, the last airship half-built in its cradle. The hub, THE CRADLE, is THE RING: a 172 m training loop around the unfinished hull and its 64 m mast (the landmark, seen from every zone), cut in two by the keel corridor, with aimed pads up to the hull deck; each side zone is built for its verbs (THE RIBS: a canyon of 8-12 m slabs 7 m apart to wall-ride and wall-jump; THE SLIPWAY: two 40 m launch ramps down from a 10 m deck and a pad back up), and THE GANGWAY is the start, the mast in view through its door. Tonight's greybox builds these four zones; the boilerworks, the drafting office, the gantry and the pier are night 2. New design, so Unity-side (CLAUDE.md rule 5: the web never had this map); every number comes from Design/maps/drydock.plan.json, sized from the movement numbers in MAP-DESIGN.md section 1, and Assets/Editor/Maps/Build_drydock.cs turns it into this file. The map's identity is GG's decision (D-59): this is the recommended concept, built to be played and judged.

links.note: CSR: node i's links are linkStart[i] .. linkStart[i + 1] - 1; linkTo = target node, linkKind = linkKinds value, linkCost = m-equivalent cost
